messages:
tanvi: Quick check-in: post-launch backlog prioritization needed. We have three customer blockers, a perf regression alert on staging, and a pile of UX asks. Can we map to hotpatch (72h), short wave (2w), or minor (4-6w)?

jess: My take: hotpatch = customer-blocking OR data corruption OR SLO breach. Short-wave = low-risk fixes (<=2 files, no infra), toggleable. Minor = infra, model, or batching changes.

owen: From infra: KV-cache and routing tweaks should go to minor unless we can gate with a flag. They are risky.

dara: QA: two flaky stream tests and one embedding mismatch. Flakes are causing CI noise but not prod errors yet. Embedding mismatch needs model-variant evaluation -> minor.

maria: Customer note: FinServeA reports truncation on long prompts (blocking). Start date pressure: they want a fix within 6 business days.

jess: Proposal:
- Hotpatch (72h): FinServeA truncation + critical monitoring fixes. Require smoke tests + 2h canary at 3% traffic.
- Short-wave (2w): small fixes, docs, CLI flags, token-billing UX. 5% canary 4h.
- Minor (4-6w): KV cache refactor, batching rework, model variant rollout. Full canary 24h.

tanvi: Add governance: any hotpatch touching model path needs senior eng + PM signoff. Rollback criteria: error_rate > 3x baseline OR p95 latency > 2x -> rollback.

owen: I'll prepare a canary template for hotpatch.

dara: I'll prioritize smoke/regression for the hotpatch once a PR is up.

maria: I'll message FinServeA with the 6-day target and the feature-flag plan.

jess: Action items: tanvi to own final scope, owen to prep canary, dara for QA, maria for customer comms, jess to coordinate release. Follow-up tomorrow 9:30am PT in this thread. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder set for 2024-12-03 09:30 PT -> "Post-launch prioritization follow-up" (posted by jess)
